data.name: Aggressive
data.effect: As a bonus action, the creature can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature it can see.

data.name: Ambusher
data.effect: The creature has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has {@status surprised}.

data.name: Angelic Weapons
data.effect: The creature's weapon attacks are magical. When the creature hits with any weapon, the weapon deals extra radiant damage. Input this extra damage per round.

data.name: Avoidance
data.effect: If the creature is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a saving throw to only take half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

data.name: Blood Frenzy
data.effect: The creature has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

data.name: Constrict
data.effect: The creature has the ability to restrain and/or grapple a target as part of an attack.

data.name: Damage Transfer
data.effect: While attached or grappling a creature, the creature takes only half damage dealt to it (rounded down), and the other creature takes the other half.

data.name: Enlarge
data.effect: The creature magically increases in size, along with anything it is wearing or carrying. Input the extra damage inflicted per round whilst enlarged.

data.name: Frightful Presence
data.effect: Each creature of the creature's choice within range must make a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute.

data.name: Heated Body
data.effect: Touching or hitting the creature while within 5 ft. of it causes damage.

data.name: Horrifying Visage
data.effect: Each non-undead creature of the creature's choice within range must make a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute.

data.name: Legendary Resistance
data.effect: If the creature fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. Input the number of uses per day.

data.name: Magic Resistance
data.effect: The creature has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

data.name: Martial Advantage
data.effect: The creature can deal extra damage to a creature it hits if that creature is with in 5 ft. of an ally of the creature that isn't incapacitated. Input the extra damage inflicted per round.

data.name: Nimble Escape
data.effect: The creature can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

data.name: Pack Tactics
data.effect: The creature has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the creature's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

data.name: Parry
data.effect: The creature adds its proficiency bonus to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it as a reaction.

data.name: Possession
data.effect: The creature can control another creature, during which time it cannot be targeted by nearly any effect.

data.name: Regeneration
data.effect: At the beginning of the creature's turn, it regains hit points and cannot be killed until this effect is mitigated in some way, usually through acid or fire damage. Input how many hit points it regains at the beginning of its turn.

data.name: Relentless
data.effect: If the creature would be reduced to 0 hit points, there is a chance that it can instead only be reduced to 1.

data.name: Shadow Stealth
data.effect: While in dim light or darkness, the creature can take the {@action Hide} action as a bonus action.

data.name: Stench
data.effect: Any creature other than the monster within 5 feet of it must make a saving throw or be poisoned.

data.name: Superior Invisibility
data.effect: The creature can turn invisible as an action or bonus action.

data.name: Undead Fortitude
data.effect: If the creature would be reduced to 0 hit points, there is a chance that it can instead only be reduced to 1. This feature is negated if the damage is from radiant nature.

data.name: Web
data.effect: Ranged Weapon Attack that restrains the target on a hit.
